name: Drop Zone with Drag Preview
note: Reads DataTransfer.items during dragenter, before anything is dropped, so the zone can fan out one ghost card per incoming file and turn red when every type is wrong. The dashed SVG border marches on stroke-dashoffset, a radial spotlight follows dragover coordinates, and :has() compacts the zone once a file row exists.

name: Upload Queue with Retry
note: The header bar is the queue: one flex segment per file, grown by its byte size and filled by its own progress, so the bar and the rows can never disagree. A concurrency radiogroup re-schedules live, a failed transfer keeps its partial bytes until retried, and cleared rows leave with a WAAPI FLIP.

name: Reorderable Photo Grid
note: Dragging moves the real tile in the DOM and FLIPs every displaced tile with the Web Animations API, re-anchoring the held print under the pointer when the 2x2 cover slot changes its size; frame numbers are a CSS counter, so a reorder renumbers with no script. Space picks up, arrows carry it through the dense grid, Escape puts it back.

name: Paste-to-Upload Composer
note: The paste event is read for files first: screenshots are decoded with createImageBitmap and drawn into a thumbnail canvas, while long pasted text is folded into a text attachment instead of flooding the field. Chips upload behind a conic ring driven by a registered <angle> property.

note: Mapping rows share one column template through subgrid, and a highlighter stroke (a registered percentage) sweeps each matched column name. name: File Signature Inspector
note: Validation reads the first bytes of the file, not just its name: the signature is matched against PDF, PNG, JPEG, ZIP, HEIC and executable headers and drawn as a hex row with the matched bytes lit. Contents, extension, size and name checks reveal in a staggered checklist before a rubber-stamp verdict lands; a chosen file is inspected for real from file.slice(0, 16).
